# How to get every Pokemon

[Back to the guide](../players-guide.md#part-2-walkthrough-and-strategy)

One row per species, in Pokedex order. **Wild** is the best area for it and its share of that area's encounters (with the whole story open). **Egg** is the tier it hatches in, from eggs of its own region: common, rare, or legendary (legendary eggs start once 25 species are registered). **From** is the Pokemon it evolves from and how. A species with no art yet cannot appear anywhere until its sprite exists.
